summary: Master customer journey mapping to reduce friction, redesign touchpoints, and improve CX decisions through practical workshops and templates.
lede: Customer journey mapping training helps CX and service professionals map customer steps, emotions, channels, and handoffs to identify friction and prioritize redesign. It develops skills in persona definition, Voice of Customer and behavior-data analysis, pain-point prioritization, and future-state service blueprinting, so teams can turn findings into a practical redesign roadmap and communicate decisions using customer experience measures.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you already work with customer feedback, service improvement, or digital experience and need a more structured way to map journeys, prioritize pain points, and present redesign decisions. CX Managers responsible for journey performance and service redesign. Customer Experience Analysts who synthesize VOC, survey, and behavior data. Service Designers building current-state and future-state journey maps. Product Owners aligning product changes to customer touchpoints. Service Operations Managers fixing handoffs and recovery points. Customer Insights Specialists turning research into redesign priorities. Digital Experience Managers improving web and app touchpoints. Contact Center Managers reducing friction in assisted service channels. Business Analysts mapping process gaps behind customer pain points. Customer Success Leads coordinating retention journeys and escalation paths.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and a real or sample customer journey, plus any existing Voice of Customer material, survey results, interview notes, or service process documentation you can share. Basic familiarity with customer experience or service operations is expected, and you should be ready to work with workshop templates, sticky-note style synthesis, and simple dashboard views.
